## Overview

SPIE Optics + Photonics includes "Infrared Remote Sensing and Instrumentation XXXIII" with sessions on Fourier-transform spectrometers, hyperspectral imagers, and radiometric calibration. Directly relevant to spectral emissivity measurement and IR instrumentation.
